issue: Collocation: 'meminta KTP baru' reads like asking a person for a favor; the fixed verb for documents is 'mengurus' (which id-3301's own tip calls THE bureaucracy verb). Process itself (police loss report first) is accurate.

fix.target: Sebelum mengurus KTP baru, saya harus melaporkan kehilangannya ke kantor polisi.
fix.english: Before sorting out a new ID card, I have to report the loss to the police station.

issue: Process error: the stated order (akta kelahiran first, THEN name enters KK) is backwards. Adding a newborn to the KK needs the hospital's surat keterangan lahir, not the akta; under Dukcapil's integrated service the akta, updated KK, and KIA are issued together in one visit. The card teaches a wrong bureaucratic sequence in the node whose whole point is sequence accuracy.

fix.target: Nama anak dimasukkan ke kartu keluarga bersamaan dengan pengurusan akta kelahirannya.
fix.english: The child's name is added to the family card at the same time as the birth certificate is processed.
fix.grammar: Bersamaan dengan = at the same time as: diurus bersamaan = processed together — one Dukcapil visit.

issue: Process pairing slightly off: a blurry photo on the card is fixed by cetak ulang (reprint); rekam ulang (biometric re-capture) is triggered by failed fingerprint/iris data. The classic rekam-ulang cause makes the sentence process-true.

fix.target: Data e-KTP saya harus direkam ulang karena sidik jari saya gagal terbaca.
fix.english: My e-KTP data has to be recorded again because my fingerprints failed to be read.

issue: Tip imprecision: 'Doubling adds repetition' implies bolak-balik is plain reduplication, but 'bolak' never occurs alone — it is an ablaut (sound-flipped) double of balik. A learner following the tip might coin *pergi-pergi for 'back and forth'.

fix.grammar: Bolak-balik = back and forth — a sound-flipped double of balik. Same family: mondar-mandir, warna-warni.

issue: Gloss calque (English side): 'to make a passport' mirrors membuat paspor literally; natural English is 'apply for a passport'. Target sentence and the parental-consent requirement itself are accurate.

fix.english: A minor needs a parental permission letter to apply for a passport.

issue: Terminology: 'tempat berobat pertama' is a paraphrase nobody at a BPJS counter uses — the universal word is 'faskes pertama' (faskes tingkat satu). It appears on every form and in every queue conversation; the card should teach it.

fix.target: Pilih dulu klinik terdekat sebagai faskes pertama kamu.
fix.english: First choose the nearest clinic as your first-level care facility.
fix.grammar: Faskes (fasilitas kesehatan) pertama = your first-stop BPJS clinic — the word on every form.

issue: Currency: the kelas 1-2-3 room system is being phased out — Perpres 59/2024 mandated the standard inpatient class (KRIS) in place of class-based rooms from mid-2025, so 'kelas rawat menentukan kamar' is stale-to-wrong for a 2026 learner walking into a hospital.

fix.target: Kamar pasien BPJS sekarang mulai disamakan lewat kelas rawat inap standar.
fix.english: BPJS patient rooms are now starting to be standardized through the standard inpatient class.
fix.grammar: KRIS (kelas rawat inap standar) is replacing the old kelas 1–3 — one standard room class for all.

issue: Factual ambiguity: Rp2.500 is specifically the BI-Fast rate; the traditional realtime-online interbank channel still charges Rp6.500. Stated bare, the card sets up a surprise at the ATM. A one-line tip disambiguates.

fix.grammar: Rp2.500 is the BI-Fast rate; the older 'online' transfer channel still costs Rp6.500.

issue: Stale terminology: from the 2025/2026 intake, PPDB was rebranded SPMB and 'jalur zonasi' was renamed 'jalur domisili' (placement by home address). Parents still say zonasi colloquially, but a card teaching the official track name should teach the current one.

fix.target: Kami mendaftarkan anak ke sekolah dekat rumah lewat jalur domisili.
fix.english: We registered our child at a school near home through the residence track.
fix.grammar: Jalur domisili = placement by home address — the 2025 rename of the old jalur zonasi.

issue: Tip overclaims: 'one month's salary, required by law' is only true for employees with 12+ months' service; shorter tenure gets a prorated THR. The H-7 payment deadline in the sentence itself is accurate.

fix.grammar: THR = Tunjangan Hari Raya, the holiday bonus: a full month's pay after a year's service, by law.

issue: Logic/custom error: Imlek is a one-day national holiday — falling on a Monday cannot by itself close an office for two days. The real two-day closure comes from cuti bersama (a government joint-leave day) attached to the holiday; the card misses the chance to teach that essential calendar word.

fix.target: Kantor teman saya libur dua hari karena ada cuti bersama setelah hari raya Imlek.
fix.english: My friend's office is off for two days because there is a joint leave day after Imlek.
fix.grammar: Cuti bersama = government-set joint leave glued onto holidays — Indonesia's long-weekend maker.
